milestone: XNU Source Fidelity, Genuine VM Bootstrap & Kernel Initialization
target_hardware_profile: iPhone 15 / iPhone15,4 / D37AP / Apple A16 Bionic T8120
host_toolchain: Visual Studio 2026 MSVC C++20 / Zig 0.17.0 (Freestanding aarch64-macos)

bootstrap_entry.core_affinity_query: MPIDR_EL1 checked, primary core proceeds, secondary cores park in WFE

c_runtime_abi.fp_simd: CPACR_EL1.FPEN = 0b11 enabled prior to C entry

instruction_provenance_engine.granularity: Instruction-level (PC, opcode, mnemonic, symbol, source file, category)

categories.Category_B: Adapted public XNU source compiled to guest machine code

level2_descriptors.type: Normal Cacheable RW Inner Shareable (AF=1, SH=3)
Normal Cacheable RW Inner Shareable (AF=1, SH=3)
Device-nGnRE RW Inner Shareable (AF=1, SH=3, AttrIndx=1)

virtual_memory_bootstrap.real_mmu_translation: Stage-1 table walk in MMU translates guest VA using guest-constructed page table descriptors
virtual_memory_bootstrap.wx_enforcement: Stage-1 descriptor AP[2]=1 (read-only) and UXN/PXN bits enforce W^X separation

PE_init_platform.role: Populate g_pe_state at 0x10040, validate DeviceTree & AIC presence

arm_vm_init_early.role: Multi-level 16KB page table synthesis (Level 1 + Level 2 blocks), AIC MMIO identity map

pmap_bootstrap.role: Physical bounds registration (avail_start=0x40000, avail_end=RAM end), pmap_initialized=1

secondary_core_management.state: Parked in low-power WFE spin loop until IPI wakeup

determinism_and_snapshot.replay_fidelity: Bit-exact across CPU registers, MMIO transaction log, and DRAM regions

provenance_classification.xnu_source: Apple xnu-10002.1.13 (macOS 14.0 Sonoma / iOS 17 Open Source)
